mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring additional conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.0%, it signals a deteriorating labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of periods when UNRATE > 4.0%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint rise in the federal funds rate and unemployment rate indicates a tightening monetary policy coinciding with a weakening labor market, which compresses corporate profit margins and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for the interaction term falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or negative returns occur in less than 55% of instances where both FEDFUNDS and UNRATE rise.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, rising residential construction (HOUST) and consumer credit (RSAFS) signal strong economic momentum that supports corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of periods during late-cycle expansions when both HOUST and RSAFS rise, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index indicates expanding manufacturing output and economic activity, which boosts corporate revenues and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days without any regime condition.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO rises, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation that may trigger aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: The combination of rising residential construction (HOUST) and declining industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a housing boom coupled with manufacturing slowdown, which signals economic imbalances and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year window, or negative returns occur in less than 50% of instances where HOUST rises and INDPRO falls.

mechanism_narrative: In a labor market tightening (low unemployment), a sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals strong job growth that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 40% of periods during labor market tightening when PAYEMS grows, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.
